dhp320:1: Like an elephant in battle (endures) an arrow shot from bow
dhp320:3: (so) will I endure abuse, for many people are unvirtuous.
dhp321:1: They lead one trained into a crowd, a king mounts one who has been trained,
dhp321:3: amongst humans one trained is best, the one who can endure abuse.
dhp322:1: Noble are the well-trained horses, the well-bred horses from Sindh,
dhp322:4: and the great tusker elephants, (and even) more noble than that is the one who has trained himself.
dhp323:2: Not by these vehicles can one go to the place beyond destinations,
dhp323:4: as one through training himself well, being trained by the training, goes.
dhp324:2: musty in rut, difficult to restrain,
dhp324:3: bound, he doesn’t eat (even) a morsel,
dhp324:4: the tusker remembers the elephant forest.
dhp325:1: When one is torpid and overeats,
dhp325:2: sleepy and rolling on the bed,
dhp325:3: like a great pig fed on fodder,
dhp325:4: that fool comes to the womb again.
dhp326:3: (but) today I will control it wisely,
dhp326:4: like one with goad an elephant in rut.
dhp327:2: You should delight in heedfulness, you should always protect your mind,
dhp327:3: you should raise yourself from this pit like the tusker sunk in the mud.
dhp328:1: If you should find a prudent friend
dhp328:2: or companion, one who lives well, a wise one,
dhp328:4: you should live with that one, glad and mindful.
dhp329:1: If you do not find a prudent friend
dhp329:2: or companion, one who lives well, a wise one,
dhp329:3: like a king who abandons his conquered kingdom
dhp329:4: one should live alone like a solitary elephant in the forest.
dhp330:1: It is better to live alone, there can be no friendship with a fool,
dhp330:3: one should live alone and not do anything bad,
dhp330:4: unconcerned like a solitary elephant in the forest.
dhp331:1: Friends are good whenever need arises,
dhp331:2: being content with everything is good,
dhp331:3: at the break-up of life merit is good,
dhp331:4: the abandoning of all suffering is good.
dhp332:1: Respecting one’s mother is good in the world, also respecting one’s father is good,
dhp332:4: respecting ascetics is good in the world, also respecting (true) brahmins is good.
dhp333:2: Virtuous conduct till old age is good, the establishing of faith is good,
dhp333:3: the acquisition of wisdom is good, doing nothing wicked is good.
dhp333:5: The Chapter about the Elephant, the Twenty-Third
